metadata.scenario: A customer demands a refund for erroneous charges on their bill. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Jennifer Taylor. I'm calling about some charges on my grandmother's bill. Hi Jennifer, I’m happy to help you with that. Can you tell me a bit more about the charges in question? Yes, I noticed there are charges for services we never requested. I see. Can you provide me with the specific services you're referring to? There’s a charge for companion care, but we only needed help with daily activities. Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your grandmother's account. One moment, please. Okay, I have the account here. I see the charge for companion care, which is $25 to $30 per hour. Can you tell me when the service was scheduled? It looks like it was supposed to be on the 10th, but we didn’t use it. I understand. Let me check our records to confirm that service was not provided. It appears there was a scheduling error on our end, and the service was indeed marked as provided. I apologize for the oversight. So, what happens now? Can we get a refund for that charge? Yes, we can issue a refund for that charge, and I’ll start that process for you right away. Thank you! How long will that take? Typically, it takes about 5-7 business days for the refund to process back to your account. Okay, that sounds good. Also, can you confirm if my grandmother's regular services will continue without interruption? Yes, her regular services for personal care assistance will continue as scheduled. Great! I’m also interested in companion care for her during the weekdays. We can set that up. Companion care is $25 to $30 per hour, depending on the caregiver matched. That sounds good, can we schedule that? Absolutely! Can I take your grandmother's preferred times for weekdays? Yes, she would need help on Mondays and Wednesdays, from 10 AM to 2 PM. Perfect. I’ll schedule that and ensure a caregiver is assigned. Thank you so much for your help today, Margaret. You’re welcome, Jennifer! I’ll send you a confirmation email with the details shortly. I appreciate it. Goodbye! Goodbye! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health.
